selection: All remaining proxy pairs with initial clearance in (0.0001, 0.1) mm and sampled minimum <=0.05 mm
limitations: Only the initial keyframe and selected non-overlapping proxy pairs. Witness to nearest CAD face is not the CAD body-to-body clearance or proof of collision. CAD-frame correspondence relies on previous approximate mapping; angles and CAD configuration may differ. Pairs not selected are not assessed.
